tools.name: about
tools.description: Short description of Byteland: what buildings, rooms and lights stand for, units, privacy rules and supported languages. A good first call.

tools.name: get_street
tools.description: Buildings in a range (owner, type, floors, light counts) and gaps (alleys, empty lots). Positions in centimetres, at most 80000 cm.

tools.name: get_building
tools.description: Public detail of one building: the owner’s profile, rooms and their states, machine-readable parts and the building recipe.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: A developer’s or company’s profile: bio, links (GitHub, website, socials), badges, projects and open-source contributions. If not on the street, looks for a saved profile, then GitHub; otherwise generates a sample (preview:true).

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: A profile’s projects: state, description, stack, links (repo, site) plus open-source contributions. Private projects appear only as hidden:true.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: A single project of a profile. Returns nothing for private projects.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find people, projects and stacks across every resident of the city (people, projects, stacks), plus buildings on the street by username, name, project or technology (results). Private projects never appear.

tools.name: popular
tools.description: The leaderboard: buildings by unique visits this week (or period: "all"), the most viewed projects and the newest residents. A visit counts once per person per day; owners do not count themselves.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Unique visits (all time and this week), project views, weekly rank and the last 14 days for one username.

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: The project rooms of a person that have been used (every public project of a resident has a room, open by default; one nobody wrote in is empty and not listed): mode (open or read-only), channels with message counts, forum threads, last activity and how many are in voice. Closed rooms and private pr

tools.name: read_room
tools.description: The latest messages of one channel of a project room (default: its first channel) and the forum threads (idea, review, question, announcement) with reply and reaction counts.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: One forum thread of a project room with all of its replies and reactions.

tools.name: live
tools.description: Voice rooms with people in them right now and the rooms with messages in the last 48 hours. Voice presence comes from the running site (BYTELAND_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:8787); without it only the recent rooms are known.

tools.name: preview_building
tools.description: Builds a user's building as if it stood at the start of a street (GitHub repositories become rooms). The preview is not added to the city. Append the returned url_hash to index.html to open it on the site.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
